summary: Iteration 13 retest of the two previously-failing issues on ACME offense 5dd6f7e7 (Suspicious PowerShell Encoded Command Execution) in LLM mode. Backend: test_iteration_12.py (3/3 pass in 34s) and new test_iteration_13.py (1/1 pass in 42s) verify no bare all-caps section markers (regex ^[A-Z][A-Z0-9 _/&-]{1,40}:?$) in recommendations, review-logs pointer present, and IOC enrichment populated with source_ip=45.155.204.199. Frontend UI on /offenses/5dd6f7e7 → 'mssp report' tab renders the full report end-to-end: Local LLM badge + Verdict SUSPICIOUS badge in header; payload fields grid shows Process=powershell.exe, Parent Process=outlook.exe, Command Line='powershell -nop -w hidden -enc SQBFAFgAKABOAGUA...'; Log source='Sysmon @ 10.10.34.12' (never CRE); Analysis has 3 technical bullets (no historical/similar-offense wording); Impact 5 bullets; Recommendations 6 bullets with 'Review the Sysmon logs and correlate ...' as final bullet and NO bare 'VARIABLES:'/'NOTES:' markers; IOC Enrichment section (offense-mssp-report-ioc-enrichment) renders with 'Source IP 45.155.204.199 was reviewed. The IP belongs to Cloud.ru. Geolocation: RU. Reputation score: 0 malicious / 0 suspicious.' plus VirusTotal link — TI-based verdict is now consistent; Verdict reason at bottom is grounded (references Base64-encoded command, not a stale TI claim). Section order in DOM (top-to-bottom, excluding the header verdict badge): Analysis → Impact → Recommendations → IOC Enrichment → Verdict Reason.

rca of the issue: Iteration 3 rec-bullet #5 'VARIABLES:' leak was caused by _sanitize_bullets in llm_engine.py not filtering bare all-caps section markers — the added regex ^[A-Z][A-Z0-9 _/&-]{1,40}:?$ now drops them. The null IOC enrichment issue was caused by _pick_external_ip only looking at offense IP fields (both internal 10.10.34.12); server.py now passes analysis.iocs.ipv4_external to _vt_ioc_enrichment so the extracted external IP 45.155.204.199 is correctly enriched by VirusTotal.
